system issuer

  • CURIE: gmeow:systemIssuer
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/systemIssuer
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/norms
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

The agent or standpoint that issues a normative system as a whole. ⊑ normIssuer: issuing the system is issuing its stance. Member norms may still carry their own issuers (an annex contributed by another party).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:NormativeSystem -> ? Sub-property of: gmeow:normIssuer

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:systemIssuer from gmeow:NormativeSystem to ? when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:normIssuer, gmeow:NormativeSystem

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to name the agent or standpoint that issues a whole normative system.

Avoid when

  • Avoid using it on a single norm (use the general gmeow:normIssuer) and avoid assuming member norms inherit the system's issuer — an annex may carry its own.

How to use

  • Assert gmeow:systemIssuer from the gmeow:NormativeSystem to its issuer; it specializes gmeow:normIssuer, so the system's issuance surfaces in generic issuer queries.

Examples

  • ex:gdpr gmeow:systemIssuer ex:euParliament.
